exposure: Parental biological relationship (biological mother vs. non-biological parent)
Number of children in the family
outcome: Reliability/accuracy of parental recall of birth parameters (birth weight, birth length, gestational age) compared to medical records
Accuracy of gestational age within 2 weeks
cohort: The cohort comprised 4930 children aged 2 to 11 years from the European multicentric IDEFICS study, whose parents provided recalled birth parameters.
finding: Parental recall of birth parameters (weight, length, gestational age) generally matched well with medical records, though accuracy varied based on socioeconomic status, parental biological relationship, and number of children.
